standards.title: Perform in informal settings

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students manipulate elements of music to communicate ideas and meaning when composing and practising.

standards.title: Sing and play learnt and composed music

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students sing and play learnt and composed music in informal settings.

standards.title: Visual arts across cultures and times
standards.description: explore where, why and how visual arts are created and/or presented across cultures, times, places and/or other contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how visual arts are created and presented across cultures, times and places.

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how First Nations Australians use visual arts to communicate connection to Country/Place.

standards.title: Experiment with range of conventions
standards.description: experiment with a range of ways to use visual conventions, visual arts processes and materials
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students experiment with a range of visual conventions, processes and materials.

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use visual conventions, processes and materials to create artworks communicating ideas and meaning.

standards.title: Share and display in informal settings

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how elements of dance combine to communicate ideas across cultures, times and places.

standards.title: First Nations dance and culture
standards.description: explore the ways that First Nations Australians use dance to continue and revitalise cultures
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how First Nations Australians use dance to continue and revitalise cultures.

standards.title: Technical and expressive skills

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop and practise technical and expressive skills using safe dance practice and elements of dance.

standards.title: Manipulate elements and devices

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students manipulate elements of dance and choreographic devices to choreograph dances communicating ideas and meaning.

standards.title: Perform with technical skills

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students practise and perform dances using technical and expressive skills in informal and formal settings.

standards.title: Elements combine to communicate meaning

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how elements of drama combine to communicate ideas across cultures, times and places.

standards.title: First Nations drama and culture
standards.description: explore the ways that First Nations Australians use drama to continue and revitalise cultures
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how First Nations Australians use drama to continue and revitalise cultures.

standards.title: Combine elements to communicate
standards.description: explore ways to combine the elements of drama to communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning in improvisations, devised drama and/or scripted drama
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore ways to combine elements of drama in improvisations, devised and scripted drama.

standards.title: Develop characters and dramatic action
standards.description: develop characters and situations, and shape and sustain dramatic action to communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning in improvised, devised and/or scripted forms
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop characters and sustain dramatic action to communicate ideas in improvised, devised and scripted forms.

standards.title: Rehearse and perform in varied settings
standards.description: rehearse and perform improvised, devised and/or scripted drama in informal and/or formal settings
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students rehearse and perform improvised, devised and scripted drama in informal and formal settings.

standards.title: Media languages across contexts
standards.description: explore ways that media languages and media technologies are used in media arts works and practices across cultures, times, places and/or other contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how media languages and technologies are used in media arts across cultures, times and places.

standards.title: First Nations media arts and culture
standards.description: explore ways First Nations Australians use media arts to continue and revitalise cultures
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how First Nations Australians use media arts to continue and revitalise cultures.

standards.title: Develop production skills for meaning
standards.description: develop media production skills to communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning through manipulation of media languages and media technologies
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop media production skills to communicate ideas through manipulation of media languages and technologies.

standards.title: Construct works for specific audiences
standards.description: use media languages, media technologies and production processes to construct media arts works that communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning for specific audiences
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use media languages, technologies and production processes to construct works communicating ideas for specific audiences.

standards.title: Present with responsible media practice
standards.description: present media arts works in informal and/or formal settings using responsible media practice
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students present media arts works in informal and formal settings using responsible media practice.

standards.title: Elements combined across contexts
standards.description: explore ways that the elements of music are combined in music across cultures, times, places and/or other contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how elements of music are combined across cultures, times and places.

standards.title: First Nations music and culture
standards.description: explore ways First Nations Australians use music to continue and revitalise culture
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how First Nations Australians use music to continue and revitalise culture.

standards.title: Listening and expressive skills
standards.description: develop listening/aural skills and skills for manipulating elements of music to achieve expressive effects when composing, singing and playing instruments
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop listening and aural skills for manipulating musical elements to achieve expressive effects.

standards.title: Compose with devices and notation
standards.description: manipulate elements of music and use compositional devices to communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning when composing and practising music for performance, and notate, document and/or record the music they compose
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students manipulate elements and use compositional devices when composing, and notate or record their music.

standards.title: Perform in informal and formal settings
standards.description: perform music in a range of forms they have learnt and/or composed in informal and/or formal settings
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students perform learnt and composed music in informal and formal settings.

standards.title: Visual conventions communicate meaning
standards.description: explore ways that visual conventions, visual arts processes and materials are combined to communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning in visual arts across cultures, times, places and/or other contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how visual conventions and materials combine to communicate ideas across cultures, times and places.

standards.title: First Nations visual arts and culture
standards.description: explore ways that First Nations Australians use visual arts to continue and revitalise cultures
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how First Nations Australians use visual arts to continue and revitalise cultures.

standards.title: Experiment, document and reflect
standards.description: experiment with, document and reflect on ways to use a range of visual conventions, visual arts processes, and materials
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students experiment with, document and reflect on a range of visual conventions, processes and materials.

standards.title: Plan and create artworks
standards.description: use visual conventions, visual arts processes and materials to plan and create artworks that communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use visual conventions, processes and materials to plan and create artworks communicating ideas.

standards.title: Present documentation and display
standards.description: select and present documentation of visual arts practice, and display artworks in informal and/or formal settings
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students select and present documentation of visual arts practice and display artworks in informal and formal settings.

standards.title: Investigate dance works across contexts
standards.description: investigate ways that dance works, performers and/or choreographers across cultures, times, places and/or other contexts use the elements of dance, choreographic devices and/or production elements to communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how dance works across cultures and contexts use elements, devices and production elements to communicate meaning.

standards.title: Diversity of First Nations dance
standards.description: investigate the diversity of dance choreographed and/or performed by First Nations Australians considering culturally responsive approaches to Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property rights
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate the diversity of First Nations Australian dance considering culturally responsive approaches and ICIP rights.

standards.title: Safe dance and genre techniques
standards.description: develop safe dance practice and use of expressive and technical skills and, as appropriate, genre- or style-specific techniques
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop safe dance practice and expressive and technical skills including genre-specific techniques.

standards.title: Reflect to inform choices
standards.description: reflect on own and others' dance works and/or practices to inform choreographic choices and use of technical and expressive skills
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students reflect on own and others' dance works to inform choreographic choices and skill development.

standards.title: Choreograph to communicate meaning
standards.description: choreograph dance by selecting and manipulating elements of dance and choreographic devices to communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students choreograph dance by selecting and manipulating elements and devices to communicate ideas and meaning.

standards.title: Apply skills to communicate meaning
standards.description: apply technical and expressive skills and/or genre- or style-specific techniques to communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply technical and expressive skills and genre techniques to communicate ideas and meaning.

standards.title: Rehearse and perform for audiences
standards.description: rehearse and perform dance for audiences, using technical and expressive skills and, as appropriate genre- or style-specific techniques
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students rehearse and perform dance for audiences using technical and expressive skills and genre techniques.

standards.title: Investigate drama elements
standards.description: investigate ways the elements of drama and/or conventions are used to communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning in drama created and/or performed across cultures, times, places and/or other contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how elements and conventions communicate meaning in drama across cultures, times and places.

standards.title: Diversity of First Nations drama
standards.description: investigate the diversity of drama created and/or performed by First Nations Australians, considering culturally responsive approaches to Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property rights
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate the diversity of First Nations Australian drama considering culturally responsive approaches and ICIP rights.

standards.title: Performance skills for styles and forms
standards.description: develop performance skills relevant to selected drama styles and/or forms
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop performance skills relevant to selected drama styles and forms.

standards.title: Reflect to inform dramatic choices
standards.description: reflect on their own and others' drama to inform choices when manipulating elements of drama and/or conventions to shape dramatic action
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students reflect on own and others' drama to inform choices when manipulating elements and conventions.

standards.title: Improvise, devise and interpret drama
standards.description: improvise and devise drama and/or interpret scripted drama, manipulating elements of drama and applying conventions relevant to the style/form
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students improvise, devise and interpret scripted drama, manipulating elements and applying relevant conventions.

standards.title: Evaluate and refine dramatic action
standards.description: evaluate and refine use of elements of drama and/or conventions to shape and sustain dramatic action and/or communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students evaluate and refine use of elements and conventions to shape dramatic action and communicate meaning.

standards.title: Rehearse and perform for audiences
standards.description: rehearse and perform improvised, devised and/or scripted drama to audiences, using performance skills and conventions relevant to style and/or form
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students rehearse and perform drama for audiences using performance skills and relevant conventions.

standards.title: Investigate media arts concepts
standards.description: investigate the ways that media arts concepts are used in media arts works and practices across cultures, times, places and/or other contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how media arts concepts are used in works and practices across cultures, times and places.

standards.title: Diversity of First Nations media arts
standards.description: investigate the diversity of First Nations Australians' media arts works and practices, considering culturally responsive approaches to Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property rights
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate the diversity of First Nations media arts works considering culturally responsive approaches and ICIP rights.

standards.title: Production skills in process
standards.description: develop media production skills throughout the production process to construct representations using media languages and media technologies
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop media production skills throughout the production process to construct representations.

standards.title: Reflect to inform production choices
standards.description: reflect on their own and others' media arts works and practices to inform choices they make during the production process
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students reflect on own and others' media arts works to inform choices during the production process.

standards.title: Design and structure media arts works
standards.description: design and structure media arts works to communicate ideas, perspectives and meaning for an intended audience
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students design and structure media arts works to communicate ideas and meaning for an intended audience.

standards.title: Apply production for audiences
standards.description: apply production processes and use media arts concepts to construct representations and produce media arts works that communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning for specific audiences using responsible media practice
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply production processes to construct and produce media arts works for specific audiences using responsible media practice.

standards.title: Present for audience relationships
standards.description: present media arts works, using responsible media practices and considering potential relationships the work could create with audiences
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students present media arts works using responsible media practices and considering potential audience relationships.

standards.title: Investigate composers and elements
standards.description: investigate the ways that composers and/or performers use the elements of music and/or compositional devices in music composed across cultures, times, places and/or other contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how composers and performers use elements and devices across cultures, times and places.

standards.title: Diversity of First Nations music
standards.description: investigate the diversity of music composed and/or performed by First Nations Australians, considering culturally responsive approaches to Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property rights
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate the diversity of First Nations music considering culturally responsive approaches and ICIP rights.

standards.title: Aural and instrumental skills
standards.description: develop and practise listening/aural skills and vocal and/or instrumental skills/techniques for manipulating elements of music to achieve expressive effects
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop aural and vocal/instrumental skills for manipulating musical elements to achieve expressive effects.

standards.title: Reflect to inform composition
standards.description: reflect on their own and others' music to inform choices they make as composers and performers about how they will manipulate elements of music and/or compositional devices
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students reflect on own and others' music to inform compositional and performance choices.

standards.title: Interpret with vocal/instrumental skills
standards.description: interpret music in a variety of forms and/or styles, manipulating elements of music and employing relevant vocal/instrumental techniques
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students interpret music in varied forms and styles using relevant vocal and instrumental techniques.

standards.title: Compose and notate music
standards.description: compose using the elements of music and compositional devices to communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning, and notate, document and/or record the music
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students compose using elements and devices to communicate ideas and meaning, and notate or record the music.

standards.title: Perform with instrumental skills
standards.description: perform music using relevant vocal and/or instrumental techniques and performance skills
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students perform music using relevant vocal and instrumental techniques and performance skills.

standards.title: Investigate conventions and meaning
standards.description: investigate ways that visual conventions, visual arts processes and materials are manipulated to represent ideas, perspectives and/or meaning in artworks created across cultures, times, places and/or other contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how visual conventions and materials are manipulated to represent ideas across cultures, times and places.

standards.title: Diversity of First Nations visual arts
standards.description: investigate the diversity of First Nations Australians' artworks and arts practices, considering culturally responsive approaches to Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property rights
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate the diversity of First Nations artworks and practices considering culturally responsive approaches and ICIP rights.

standards.title: Experiment to develop skills
standards.description: experiment with visual conventions, visual arts processes and materials to develop skills
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students experiment with visual conventions, processes and materials to develop skills.

standards.title: Reflect on influences to inform practice
standards.description: reflect on the ways that they and other artists respond to influences to inform choices they make in their own visual arts practice
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students reflect on how they and other artists respond to influences to inform choices in their own practice.

standards.title: Generate and develop ideas
standards.description: generate, document and develop ideas for artworks
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students generate, document and develop ideas for artworks.

standards.title: Select and manipulate for meaning
standards.description: select and manipulate visual conventions, visual arts processes and/or materials to create artworks that represent ideas, perspectives and/or meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students select and manipulate visual conventions and materials to create artworks representing ideas and meaning.

standards.title: Curate and present visual arts practice
standards.description: curate and present examples of their visual arts practice to accompany exhibits of their artworks to communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning to audiences
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students curate and present visual arts practice alongside exhibits to communicate ideas and meaning to audiences.

standards.title: Investigate choreographers and meaning
standards.description: investigate performers' and/or choreographers' use of elements of dance, choreographic devices, genre- or style-specific techniques, conventions and/or production elements to communicate and/or challenge ideas, perspectives and/or meaning in dance across cultures, times, places and/or other contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how choreographers use elements, devices, techniques and production elements to communicate and challenge meaning across contexts.

standards.title: First Nations identity and challenge
standards.description: investigate the ways First Nations Australian choreographers and/or performers celebrate and challenge multiple perspectives of Australian identity through dance
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how First Nations choreographers celebrate and challenge perspectives of Australian identity through dance.

standards.title: Refine safe dance and genre techniques
standards.description: develop and refine safe dance practice, expressive and technical skills and genre- or style-specific techniques
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop and refine safe dance practice, expressive and technical skills and genre-specific techniques.

standards.title: Reflect to inform choreographic choices
standards.description: reflect on own and others' use of the elements of dance, choreographic devices, structure, genre- or style-specific techniques and/or technical and expressive skills to inform their choreographic or performance choices
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students reflect on own and others' use of dance elements and techniques to inform choreographic and performance choices.

standards.title: Choreograph to communicate and challenge
standards.description: choreograph dance that communicates ideas, perspectives and/or meaning by selecting and manipulating elements of dance, choreographic devices and/or structure
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students choreograph dance communicating ideas and meaning by selecting and manipulating elements, devices and structure.

standards.title: Apply skills to enhance communication
standards.description: apply technical and expressive skills and genre- or style-specific techniques to enhance communication of ideas, perspectives and/or meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply technical and expressive skills and genre techniques to enhance communication of ideas and meaning.

standards.title: Rehearse and perform with genre skills
standards.description: rehearse and perform dance for audiences, using technical and expressive skills and genre- or style-specific techniques
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students rehearse and perform dance for audiences using technical and expressive skills and genre-specific techniques.

standards.title: Investigate drama to challenge meaning
standards.description: investigate use of elements of drama, performance skills and/or conventions to communicate and/or challenge ideas, perspectives and/or meaning in drama across cultures, times, places and/or other contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how drama uses elements, skills and conventions to communicate and challenge ideas across contexts.

standards.title: First Nations drama and identity
standards.description: investigate the ways that drama created and/or performed by First Nations Australians celebrates and challenges multiple perspectives of Australian identity
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how First Nations drama celebrates and challenges perspectives of Australian identity.

standards.title: Performance skills for characters
standards.description: develop performance skills and/or techniques to manipulate elements of drama and/or use conventions to communicate the physical and psychological aspects of roles and characters consistent with intentions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop performance skills to communicate physical and psychological aspects of roles and characters.

standards.title: Reflect to refine dramatic practice
standards.description: reflect on their own and others' drama or practices to refine and inform their use of elements of drama, conventions and/or approaches to shape and sustain dramatic action
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students reflect on own and others' drama to refine use of elements, conventions and approaches.

standards.title: Improvise, devise and interpret
standards.description: improvise and devise drama, and interpret scripted drama, using elements of drama and conventions to shape and manipulate dramatic action and convey intended ideas, perspectives and/or meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students improvise, devise and interpret drama using elements and conventions to convey intended ideas and meaning.

standards.title: Rehearse and refine aesthetic choices
standards.description: rehearse and refine drama making deliberate aesthetic choices to unify dramatic meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students rehearse and refine drama making deliberate aesthetic choices to unify dramatic meaning.

standards.title: Perform to audiences with intention
standards.description: perform improvised, devised and/or scripted drama to audiences, using performance skills and conventions to shape the drama
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students perform improvised, devised and scripted drama to audiences using performance skills and conventions.

standards.title: Investigate media artists
standards.description: investigate the ways that media artists use media arts concepts to construct representations in media arts works and practices across cultures, times, places and/or other contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how media artists use media arts concepts to construct representations across cultures, times and places.

standards.title: First Nations media and identity
standards.description: investigate the ways First Nations Australian media artists and/or producers celebrate and challenge multiple perspectives of Australian identity through media arts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how First Nations media artists celebrate and challenge perspectives of Australian identity.

standards.title: Construct representations with intention
standards.description: experiment with ways to construct representations that reflect ideas, perspectives and/or meaning, and/or use of media conventions, media languages and media technologies
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students experiment with constructing representations using media conventions, languages and technologies.

standards.title: Reflect to refine production choices
standards.description: reflect on their own or others' media arts works and/or practices to refine and inform choices they make during stages of the production process
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students reflect on own and others' media arts works to refine and inform choices throughout the production process.

standards.title: Design to examine and communicate
standards.description: design and structure media arts works that examine and communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students design and structure media arts works that examine and communicate ideas and meaning.

standards.title: Produce works for/challenging audiences
standards.description: apply production processes and use media arts concepts to construct representations and produce media arts works that communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning, and confirm or challenge the expectations of specific audiences
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply production processes to produce media arts works that communicate meaning and confirm or challenge audience expectations.

standards.title: Present and distribute with planning
standards.description: present media arts works to audiences and plan approaches for creating relationships with audiences if/when media arts works are distributed in selected contexts using responsible media practice
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students present media arts works and plan distribution approaches for creating audience relationships using responsible media practice.

standards.title: Investigate composers across contexts
standards.description: investigate composers' and/or performers' use of elements of music, compositional devices and/or vocal/instrumental techniques in music from a range of cultures, times, places and/or other contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how composers and performers use elements, devices and techniques across cultures, times and places.

standards.title: First Nations music and identity
standards.description: investigate the ways that First Nations Australian performers and/or composers celebrate and challenge multiple perspectives of Australian identity through music
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how First Nations performers and composers celebrate and challenge perspectives of Australian identity.

standards.title: Refine aural and style-specific skills
standards.description: develop, practise and refine the use of listening/aural skills and style-specific vocal instrumental skills/techniques to interpret music and communicate expressive effects
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop, practise and refine aural and style-specific skills to interpret music and communicate expressive effects.

standards.title: Reflect to refine interpretation
standards.description: reflect on their own and others' music to inform choices they make as composers and performers about how they will interpret and/or manipulate elements of music and/or compositional devices
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students reflect on own and others' music to refine interpretation and compositional choices.

standards.title: Interpret with style-specific techniques
standards.description: interpret music in a variety of forms and styles, manipulating the elements of music and/or compositional devices, and using style-specific vocal/instrumental techniques to communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students interpret music in varied forms and styles using style-specific techniques to communicate ideas and meaning.

standards.title: Compose in chosen styles with notation
standards.description: compose music, manipulating and combining elements of music and compositional devices relevant to chosen styles and/or forms to communicate ideas, perspectives and/or meaning and notate, document and/or record the music
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students compose music manipulating elements and devices in chosen styles and notate or record the work.

standards.title: Rehearse and present performances
standards.description: rehearse and present planned performances of music they have learnt and/or composed, using relevant vocal/instrumental techniques and performance skills
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students rehearse and present planned performances using relevant vocal and instrumental techniques and performance skills.

standards.title: Investigate personal expression
standards.description: investigate the ways that artists across cultures, times, places and/or other contexts develop personal expression in their visual arts practice to represent, communicate and/or challenge ideas, perspectives and/or meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how artists develop personal expression to represent, communicate and challenge ideas across cultures and contexts.

standards.title: First Nations arts and identity
standards.description: investigate the ways that First Nations Australian artists celebrate and challenge multiple perspectives of Australian identity through their artworks and visual arts practice
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how First Nations artists celebrate and challenge perspectives of Australian identity.

standards.title: Refine skills and personal expression
standards.description: experiment with visual conventions, visual arts processes and materials to refine skills and develop personal expression
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students experiment with visual conventions and materials to refine skills and develop personal expression.

standards.title: Reflect to develop and resolve practice
standards.description: reflect on the way they and other visual artists respond to influences to inspire, develop and resolve choices they make in their own visual arts practice
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students reflect on how they and other artists respond to influences to develop and resolve choices in their own practice.

standards.title: Evaluate feedback to refine practice
standards.description: evaluate critical feedback when planning, developing and refining their visual arts practice
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students evaluate critical feedback when planning, developing and refining their visual arts practice.

standards.title: Create with personal expression
standards.description: select and manipulate visual conventions, visual arts processes and/or materials to create artworks that reflect personal expression, and represent and/or challenge, ideas, perspectives and/or meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students select and manipulate conventions and materials to create artworks reflecting personal expression and challenging ideas.

standards.title: Evaluate and curate exhibitions
standards.description: evaluate art exhibits to inform the curation and exhibition of their own and/or others' artworks and/or visual arts practice
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students evaluate art exhibits to inform the curation and exhibition of their own and others' artworks.
